baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-II participial plural مُكَذِّبِينَ in لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus names a collective as agents who assign falsehood to a report or its bearer; the lamed phrase makes that active stance the recipient-category of woe.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or its bearer false supplies the literal attribution act and makes the focus collective active deniers rather than merely mistaken people.

changed_reading.after: Woe falls on active discreditors who characterize a report or its bearer as false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُكَذِّبِينَ, anchored in the ك ذ ب polarity between falsehood and truth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The label can classify a sustained stance against truth in speech or action, not only an isolated inaccurate statement.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the literal polarity and frames the focus group as maintaining that opposition.

changed_reading.before: People who happen to hold an incorrect belief.
changed_reading.after: A collective whose speech or conduct actively occupies the false side of a truth-falsehood opposition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ك ذ ب inventory attached to مُكَذِّبِينَ includes a charge that proves true by being carried through or false by failing.
baseline_models.mechanism: By branch analogy, an oppositional undertaking can be called false when it fails to make good on itself; the focus may therefore carry a performance test alongside propositional denial.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves false by not being carried through supplies the literal performance test and opens a failed-undertaking reading of denial.

changed_reading.before: Deniers make a false verbal judgment.
changed_reading.after: Their oppositional stance may itself prove false by failing to carry through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ك ذ ب branch of cloth that deceives by its condition remains attached to مُكَذِّبِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Falsehood can be emitted by an appearance or state as well as by speech, opening a provisional reading in which deniers sustain conditions that misreport reality.

activation_trace.role: A patterned cloth that deceives by its condition supplies literal nonverbal misrepresentation and opens an appearance-based mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a spoken proposition.
changed_reading.after: Denial may also be enacted through an appearance or condition that presents reality falsely.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical label repeatedly seals different evidentiary scenes, while the finite denial in 77:29 supplies an object. The focus refrain therefore functions as a recurring verdict on an operation, not a one-time generic curse.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsehood supplies the focus category that the repeated verdict keeps reapplying.
The same literal false-attribution category at the first refrain establishes the recurring verdict form.
The finite act of declaring something false supplies the denied object and turns the repeated noun into an ongoing operation.
The late recurrence of the same attribution category shows the verdict persisting through the final behavioral test.

structural_cues: The identical refrain occurs at 77:15, 19, 24, 28, 34, 37, 40, 45, 47, and 49.
77:29 places a finite form of denial between the refrains at 77:28 and 77:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ten identical refrains and a finite denial with an object; I infer that each placement seals the preceding test with a renewed verdict. A live alternative is simple rhetorical intensification without block-by-block classification.

changed_reading.before: One isolated curse labels a fixed group.
changed_reading.after: The focus is one beat in an iterative verdict that repeatedly identifies active false-attribution across successive tests.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder becomes warning, warning specifies a threatened promise, and the promise settles into occurrence; the closing belief question tests whether any later discourse could produce assent. Denial is thus located inside a failed epistemic transition whose object is eventually realized.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report false supplies the active interruption of the reminder-to-realization sequence.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the sequence's initial attempt to restore recognition.
A warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the next pressure toward response.
A threatened promise supplies the report whose rejection has consequences.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies realization that disproves the denial by event rather than by counter-speech.
Heart-settling assent supplies the endpoint that the final question says no later discourse is likely to reach.

structural_cues: 77:5-7 orders reminder, warning, threatened promise, and occurrence consecutively.
77:50 closes the surah by asking what discourse after this could receive belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered stages; I supply the directional arrow from reminder through warning and realization toward assent, with denial blocking that movement. The stages may alternatively be parallel frames for the event rather than one causal epistemic process.

changed_reading.after: They interrupt a reminder-warning-assent process until the threatened report becomes a fixed event that refutes their attribution of falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The active false-attributors are placed immediately after speech is negated, permission is withheld, and excuse-making is blocked. Their former authority to characterize the report is reversed into the condition of respondents who cannot present a defense.

activation_trace.role: Declaring another or a report false supplies the active speech-act agency that the local sequence reverses.
Literal speech is negated, removing the channel through which false attribution had operated.
Permission and licence are withheld, making the silence procedurally imposed rather than merely accidental.
Excuse and apology name the blocked defense, converting the former accusers into undefended respondents.

structural_cues: 77:35-37 is an uninterrupted no-speech, no-permission, no-excuse, then refrain sequence.
77:38 immediately calls the setting the day of separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an agentive denial label followed by local speech, permission, and excuse negations; I infer a reversal of discursive authority from accuser to silenced respondent. Silence could alternatively signal terror or finality without specifically reversing the denial speech act.

changed_reading.before: The deniers retain the role of speakers who judge the report false.
changed_reading.after: The focus names the instant when those active false-attributors lose speech and permission and cannot defend their judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth and falsehood are not left as private rival claims: a judging separation distinguishes them, a gathering creates a common forum, and the challenge to deploy a stratagem exhausts the opposing side's counter-move.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the polarity that the post-focus proceeding publicly resolves.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the adjudicative operation.
A day or summons that gathers people supplies the public forum in which the opposed claims meet.
Stratagem and contrivance supply the challenged counter-move whose impotence closes the contest.

structural_cues: 77:37-40 forms refrain, separation and gathering, challenge, then refrain.
The focus stands at the entrance to the public separation rather than only at the end of the preceding silence scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, gathering, and a challenged stratagem; I infer a public adjudicative test that resolves the truth-falsehood polarity. The challenge may instead be a taunt after judgment, not a procedural test within it.

changed_reading.before: Woe marks a general moral opposition to truth.
changed_reading.after: Woe introduces a public proceeding where truth and falsehood are separated, all parties are assembled, and falsehood's counter-strategy is exposed as powerless.

context_deltas.mechanism: The branch test of a charge that succeeds only when carried through meets a command-to-action sequence whose response fails: speech says to bow, but the body does not bow. Denial can therefore be read as a position that proves false in performance.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true or false by being carried through supplies the performance criterion for the focus label.
An uttered command supplies the proposition that calls for embodied completion.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the required action whose explicit nonperformance makes the response fail.

structural_cues: 77:48 pairs the command and its negated bodily repetition in one ayah.
The same woe refrain follows immediately at 77:49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the failed-charge branch and a spoken command followed by bodily nonperformance; I analogize the uncompleted response to a charge that does not prove true in action. The refrain may instead condemn doctrinal denial independently of this performance criterion.

changed_reading.before: Denial is exhausted by a verbal judgment.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also embodied nonperformance: a stance is exposed as false when it will not carry the called-for response through.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deceptive-cloth branch meets a refuge that bears the name and appearance of shade while its shading and sufficiency are expressly denied. Falsehood becomes materially legible as a protective appearance that cannot perform protection.

activation_trace.role: Cloth that deceives by its condition supplies the literal misleading appearance and lets denial be modeled as a false protective surface.
Shade as covering supplies the apparent protective function offered by the named refuge.
The same covering image is explicitly negated, exposing a name or appearance without its function.
Sufficiency supplies the practical test that the apparent shelter fails.

structural_cues: 77:30 names a shade and 77:31 immediately denies both shading and protective sufficiency.
The material scene is bracketed by finite denial at 77:29 and the refrain at 77:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deceptive-appearance branch plus a shelter whose named function fails; I treat the failed shelter as a material analogue of denial's reality-misreporting surface. It may instead describe punishment without characterizing the deniers' epistemic practice.

changed_reading.before: The deniers only issue false verbal attributions.
changed_reading.after: Their denial can also be imagined as constructing an apparent refuge whose label and surface lie because it neither shades nor suffices.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The wild-animal idiom is surprising and form-distant from the active participle, but it remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the repeated command to set out toward the very thing denied. Render it only as a motion analogy for denial's career, never as the lexical gloss of مُكَذِّبِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ك ذ ب branch in which a wild animal runs a stage, stops, and looks behind, attached to focus مُكَذِّبِينَ.

activation_trace.role: Running and then stopping to look behind supplies the literal interrupted-motion image for denial's course.
Unimpeded setting-out supplies the initial free motion that will terminate at the denied destination.
The finite act of declaring something false identifies the destination that reverses the moving deniers' perspective.

changed_reading.before: The deniers verbally reject a future object while remaining outside it.
changed_reading.after: Their denial runs its course until they are sent toward the denied object and forced into the halted look-back encoded by the branch image.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The failing-milk idiom is materially remote from the participial noun, yet its exact expectation-of-duration feature is activated by enjoyment explicitly made little and followed by the refrain. Use it as an analogy for a forecast of continuity that fails, not as a direct translation or claim about milk in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ك ذ ب branch in which milk disappears or does not last as expected, attached to focus مُكَذِّبِينَ.

activation_trace.role: Milk that vanishes instead of lasting supplies the literal failure of expected continuity.
Continued allowance for enjoyment supplies the duration that appears able to persist.
Literal littleness cuts that apparent duration short and activates the failed-expectation image.

changed_reading.before: Deniers only pronounce the threatened future false.
changed_reading.after: They also live by a forecast that present enjoyment will keep yielding, a forecast exposed as false when its duration fails.

strongest_changes: Whole-surah repetition changed the focus from an isolated curse into an iterative verdict applied after distinct tests.
The adjacent no-speech, no-permission, and no-excuse sequence reversed active false-attributors into undefended respondents.
The reminder-warning-promise-occurrence-belief chain made denial a claim refuted by realization, not only by counter-assertion.
The post-focus separation, gathering, and challenge gave the truth-falsehood polarity a public adjudicative mechanism.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the repeated refrain functionally legible while also activating branch-distant performance, shelter, motion, and duration analogies without merging them into the strong agentive reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The refrain may classify each preceding evidence block, or it may chiefly provide cumulative rhetorical intensification.
The failed-charge and deceptive-shelter models are coherent analogies but remain less secure than active false-attribution and speech-role reversal.
The halted-course and nonlasting-enjoyment outliers should remain visibly qualified because their branch images are not lexical glosses of the focus form.
